verdict.rationale: Maritime has its own triggers feature that automatically wakes an agent and delivers a prompt, but the only documented trigger type is a cron schedule, which is time-based rather than event-based. Lifecycle webhooks only notify an external consumer and do not run rule-defined actions inside Maritime. Missing for 10: event-based trigger types (e.g. on incoming data or external events), user-defined condition/rule logic, documented trigger actions beyond delivering a chat prompt, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A cron trigger takes a standard five-field expression, wakes the agent on schedule, and delivers its `prompt` as a chat message on every fire.
Any Docker container becomes an agent: three endpoints get you sleep/wake, channels, and triggers.
the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers
